correctness.rationale: The a+b phase words split into Z_s and O_t. Their 01 counts are T+bms and T+ma(b-t), giving exactly gcd(a,b)-1 cross-family collision pairs. The difference in 001 is bm s(a-s)/2>0 for each such pair; all other phases already differ in 01, so the two-counter signature is injective. A primitive four-run counterexample has identical full degree<=3 decks in two distinct rotations, with equality under repetition proved by the truncated generating series. Independently enumerated 192 (a,b,m) triples with a,b<=8 and m<=3 and checked the four-run example through four repeats.
